use serde::Deserialize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

#[derive(Deserialize, Clone)]
struct RequestConfig {
    action: String,
    target: String,
    options: Options,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Clone)]
struct Options {
    verbose: bool,
    timeout: u64,
}

static CONFIG_CACHE: OnceLock<HashMap<String, RequestConfig>> = OnceLock::new();

fn init_configs(raw_toml: &str) {
    let configs: HashMap<String, RequestConfig> = raw_toml
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let config: RequestConfig = toml::from_str(line).ok()?;
            Some((config.target.clone(), config))
        })
        .collect();
    let _ = CONFIG_CACHE.set(configs);
}

// GOOD: No TOML parsing in hot path - uses pre-parsed cached config
fn handle_request(target: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let configs = CONFIG_CACHE.get().ok_or("configs not initialized")?;
    let config = configs.get(target).ok_or("unknown target")?;
    process_action(&config.action, &config.target);
    Ok(())
}

fn process_action(_action: &str, _target: &str) {}
